status: FROZEN — the internal selection referee for all v9 candidates. Preregistered in v9/preregister.design.md section 2 BEFORE the gate autopsy ran; constants below are quoted from there verbatim. Changes require a new preregistered amendment.
epistemic_status: selection-grade only. Runs entirely on pre-2026-07-28 data, including the SPENT 1217-row holdout demoted to validation targets. No result here confirms anything; confirmation belongs exclusively to v9_prospective_protocol.json.

frame.precondition: verify sha256 before every run; abort loudly on mismatch

candidate_definition.candidate: mechanism + frozen hyperparameters (one JSON blob per candidate)
candidate_definition.hyperparameter_discipline: every data-driven choice (grids, CV, shrinkage, tau, caps) uses rows dated <= 2024-12-31 ONLY; a candidate is frozen before its transfer evaluation
candidate_definition.one_shot_rule: ONE transfer evaluation per candidate, appended to stats/v9_looks.json selection_reads before the numbers are used anywhere; re-tuning a candidate after seeing its transfer scores and re-evaluating is fitting on validation by other means and is forbidden — the retuned config is a NEW candidate and must be disclosed as informed-by-a-prior-look
candidate_definition.solve_side_prior: a <= 6.0 HARD, no widening (v9/README law); prediction-layer candidates must prove exact pre-change identity (fixture) before evaluation

windows.note: walk-forward engine state always uses the full corpus causally; the windows govern FITTED SCALARS and scoring rows only

beta_discipline.method: scipy.optimize.minimize_scalar, bounds (0.001, 1.0), method bounded, xatol 1e-6, objective mean series-NLL of p_series_closed(beta, rdiff, fmt) over fit-window valid rows
beta_discipline.rule: refit per candidate per fit-window; v6 baseline refit identically on the same window (paired); NEVER on validation rows
beta_discipline.fixture: beta(FIT1, v6) must equal 0.1152 within 1e-3 or the run aborts (realized 0.115199)

scoring.T1: beta from FIT1; paired per-series d = NLL_v6 - NLL_cand on VAL1 rows (referee.delta_vector; d>0 = candidate better)
scoring.T2: beta from FIT2; same on VAL2 rows
scoring.pooled: concatenation of the two era-legal window d vectors (n=1217)
scoring.judge: testing_lab/v8/referee.paired_bootstrap_crn, iid AND block_event modes, crn.json seeds 20260728/20260729, n_boot 4000; block_event is primary
scoring.SE_blk: (ci_hi - ci_lo)/3.92 of the block_event 95% CI (percentile-normal approximation, disclosed)
scoring.both_units: every delta quoted in milli-LL AND referee.expected_roi_of_dll; window MDE printed alongside; |delta| < MDE reported as INSIDE NOISE FLOOR

advance_rule.A4: pooled point delta >= 1.773 milli (within-family pair-MDE at n=1217; cross-family candidates additionally quote 5.889m as context, floor unchanged)
advance_rule.A5: fragility, only evaluated when A1-A4 all pass: (i) drop-top-5% — remove ceil(0.05*n) pooled rows with largest d, recomputed pooled mean > 0; (ii) era-jackknife — leave-one-event-out over the 31 pooled events, min recomputed pooled mean > 0. Per-window versions reported as non-gating diagnostics.
advance_rule.verdict: ADVANCE iff A1 and A2 and A3 and A4 and A5; otherwise BLOCK
advance_rule.justification_summary: 1.0xSE + conjunction: null false-advance ~2%, power ~0.75-0.9 vs a true uniform +2.5m; A4 is the covenant noise-floor law; A5(ii) pooled so no single event exceeds ~15% of rows (a diffuse true effect survives, fold-3-style concentration dies). Full arithmetic in preregister.design.md C3.

measured_context_from_autopsy.note: realized bar heights on the v8 configs (config-dependent by design — noisy candidates face higher bars)

concentration_flag_C5.rule: any candidate carrying an inner-CV/gate score from its search stage must report leave-one-fold-out means; if dropping any single fold takes the gate mean below its firing bar, the candidate is flagged CONCENTRATED at nomination
concentration_flag_C5.consequence: flag, not auto-kill (transfer adjudicates); the flag and its folds appear in the candidate's nomination blob
concentration_flag_C5.validation: on the v8 records this flag fires for the a=28 ship only (drop-fold-2: 5.47m < 6.78m SE; drop-fold-3: 1.70m < 3.23m SE) and not for the a=4.5 configs — see v9_gate_autopsy.json gate_jackknife_C5

survivors.ladder_order: conservative -> aggressive by mean|p_cand - p_v6| on VAL2, ascending, recorded at freeze in stats/v9_ladder.json

disclosure: every transfer evaluation appends {candidate, date, T1, T2, pooled, verdict, clauses_failed} to stats/v9_looks.json selection_reads at run time
